chunks: Regarding a man who swore that if he spoke to his father or mother, he would enter into ihram for hajj, he عليه السلام said: "It is of no consequence."

key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: enters into the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on an oath to enter into ihram for hajj if one speaks to one's father or mother?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that such an oath does not carry binding effect. It concerns a condition linked to speaking to one’s father or mother and states that this formulation is not legally consequential.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Abu Abdillah (as) was asked about a man who swore that if he spoke to his father or mother, he would enter into the state of ihram for Hajj.
Imam (as) said: "It is of no consequence."
